cards.text: Zechariah the prophet has been seeing visions, one after another (Zechariah 1:8-5:11). The angel who speaks with him has been showing him what they mean (Zechariah 1:9). Now he lifts up his eyes AGAIN, and something is coming out from between two mountains.

cards.question: What does Zechariah see coming out from between the two mountains?

cards.text: Four chariots, rolling out from between two mountains of BRONZE. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and the fanciest thing I ever saw back there was a twist tie.
Red horses, black horses, white horses and dappled horses, one color for each chariot. Meanwhile I've worn the same white apron every single day since I got here.

cards.question: In Zechariah's vision, all four teams of horses are strong.
Zechariah is looking at four chariots he doesn't understand. What does he do?

answers.text: Asks the angel what they are

cards.text: Zechariah asks, "What are these, my lord?" The angel tells him they are the four spirits of heaven.

cards.question: The angel says the four spirits of heaven are going forth. Where are they going forth from?

cards.text: Then the angel gives directions. The chariot with the black horses is going toward the land of the north, and the one with the white horses toward the west.

cards.question: The angel says the chariot with the dappled horses is going toward the ___.

cards.text: These strong horses are EAGER to go. Like me when the oven timer dings, and I've singed my mustache twice racing to get there first.

cards.question: The LORD tells the eager horses to wait at the mountains a little longer.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "Go and patrol the earth." So off they go, and they patrol the earth.

cards.question: Then the LORD summons Zechariah. He says those going to the land of the north have given rest to a spirit in the land of the north. Whose spirit is it?
